description: Time-and-space plum-blossom hexagram casting: NTP clock, Chinese lunar calendar, one-key cast.

store.summary: Divination clock: NTP time, Chinese lunar calendar, press 6 to cast a hexagram.
store.description: 起卦 turns the CardputerZero into a pocket divination clock. The clock face is synced over NTP at launch; below it you get the Chinese lunar date and the four stem-branch pillars (year/month/day/hour), computed from scratch with true solar time corrected by longitude and the equation of time. Press 6 and the app casts a hexagram from that exact moment and place: the upper trigram comes from the calendar numbers, the lower trigram from the sun's azimuth at your latitude/longitude, the moving line from the hour. It then reads the hexagram in the classic plum-blossom way - body/use five-element relation, mutual hexagram for the process, changed hexagram for the outcome - and pages through a plain-language reading. H to see About.

zh-CN.title: 起卦
zh-CN.summary: 时空梅花：数字时钟 + 农历干支四柱，按 6 键以当下时刻成卦。
zh-CN.description: 「起卦」把 CardputerZero 变成一只口袋里的时间罗盘。打开即是一个 NTP 校过的数字钟，下面是自算的中国农历与干支四柱（年月日时）——年柱立春换年、月柱节气换月、日柱子正换日，时柱取真太阳时（经度 + 均时差修正）。按 6 键即以此刻此地起卦：上卦取年月日之数，下卦取该时刻太阳所在方位，动爻取加时之数；再按梅花易数本门看体用五行生克、互卦过程、变卦结果，分页给出白话断语。按 H 看关于。
